description: This PHP source file defines the class StudioModuleFactory, which manages the creation and caching of StudioModule instances for different modules in the SuiteCRM project. It includes methods for retrieving studio modules and dynamically including class definitions based on module names and file existence.

classes.name: StudioModuleFactory
classes.description: Factory class responsible for creating and caching StudioModule instances for modules within the SuiteCRM environment.

methods.name: getStudioModule
methods.description: Retrieves the StudioModule object associated with a given module name, loading it from a file if it's not already cached.
